analyzer_policy: Report exact gzip-member boundaries, decompressed size/hash/prefix, first shell-script offset when visible, and opaque post-gzip byte range. Do not assign names to unknown SStarOta header integers or post-gzip fields without corroborating evidence.

sample.post_gzip_observation: Opaque bytes exist after the gzip member and before the outer signed trailer; observed printable data includes hash-like text and Y3510PPKEY. No undocumented field semantics are assigned.

vendor_documentation.evidence: SigmaStar OTA documentation describes creating SStarOta.bin with otapack, optional begin/end scripts, appending partition/file updates, then gzip-compressing it.
SSC9381/9351 documentation describes header records with source/destination/size/update method and gzip packaging; exact iRobot field mapping is not inferred.
